mapper.select: SELECT PAYMENT_ID, ACCOUNT_NO, PAYMENT_SEQ, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM SAVINGS_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo} ORDER BY PAYMENT_SEQ
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SAVINGS_PAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo} AND PAYMENT_SEQ = #{paymentSeq} AND STATUS = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SAVINGS_PAYMENT_HISTORY (ACCOUNT_NO, PAYMENT_SEQ, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{accountNo}, #{paymentSeq}, #{paymentDate}, #{paymentAmount}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
